about: P18's draft: every Advantage's and Disadvantage's effects, sorted. Drafted 2026-10-16 by Claude (Opus) from src/data/shadows-data.js and checked against private/crb/0430_Advantages.md and 0440_Disadvantages.md (the rules text matches the book in all 87; the 34 that differ differ only in the book's italic flavor lines and table layout). k: computed = a grants row the engine reads today; rule = text the table applies, which the engine skips; candidate = a number the sheet shows but never applies (probed on main 5875bd5), asked in its area's question. Signed off on the sign-off page; the build reads the signed-off copy, never this draft.

san.title: Sanity cuts
san.q: Five Disadvantages cut Sanity ('Sanity is reduced by 5%'). The sheet's SAN max ignores all five today. Should it apply them, and is 5% five points off the max, or 5% of the max?
san.probe: SAN max 90 with each and without (stats 9).

pain.title: Pain Levels
pain.q: Terminal Disease says you're always at Pain Level 1, and Pain Tolerance ignores a Pain Level per rank. The sheet computes Pain but applies neither (Decision 213 computed only Pain Sensitive's 'once hurt' kind). Should it apply both, and which comes first when a character has both?
pain.probe: Pain Level 0 → 0 unhurt with Terminal Disease.

statMax.title: Stat maximums
statMax.q: Age, Dwarf and Giant set Stat maximums (Age: BOD 5, REF 6, MOB 6). The wizard lets Age raise BOD to 9 and says nothing. Should the wizard cap them? Giant's BOD Max 11 is past the human 10: does it raise the cap?
statMax.probe: BOD 9 with Age: no cap, no warning.

check.title: A Skill's check
check.q: Four set a number on a Skill's check with no condition: Ghost Step +3 Stealth, Defect/Flaw −2 on the Skill you pick, Field Medic +1d4 on Medical, Hyper Vigilance +1d4 on Combat Sense. The Skill rows show '1d10 + N' without them. Should the row include them (e.g. '1d10 + 7 + 1d4')?

credits.title: Starting Çredits
credits.q: Wealthy: 'Start with an additional 10,000 Ç. Gain an additional 2,000 Ç/per month for each rank.' Starting Çredits are the roll × the multiplier and nothing else. Should Wealthy add Ç10,000, and is that once or per rank?
credits.probe: Starting Çredits are rolls.credits × startingCredits.multiplier, no Wealthy.

healing.title: Healing
healing.q: Rapid Healing multiplies healing out of combat (×2, ×3, ×4 by rank). Natural healing already has a SpeedHeal multiplier the sheet uses. Should Rapid Healing multiply it too, and do the two stack?

hit.title: Take a hit
hit.q: Take a hit asks for the damage type. Scrapper halves hand-to-hand and blunt melee damage, Giant takes 4 less from Melee and Martial Arts, and Thick Skull ignores the bonus damage from head hits. Should Take a hit apply them?
hit.probe: resolveHit reads armor and the damage type; none of the three.

effects.text: Aimed shots with your off hand keep their Accuracy bonus.
MAG Essence Checks to calm, befriend or deal with an animal: TN −2.
+1 attack a round per rank with Archery weapons (not crossbows).
See the auras of the living within 30 feet, through walls: power, mood, mental and physical health.
Take 8 on Intuition when you can see the target's aura.
Someone tries to trip, throw, grapple or disarm you: a Martial Arts check at 18 negates it, and an explosion gives you a counterattack.
Aimed ranged shots that hit: +4 damage, and +2 more per rank after the first.
MAG Essence Checks: each rank turns one die showing 1 into a 2.
Take 6 on your chosen Skill: Investigation, Awareness, Basic Tech or Intuition. A different one each rank.
A stunt in combat succeeds on a natural 9 or 10, but can't explode. An opposed roll that explodes still has to be beaten.
A Major Contact with real reach, more each rank. Not always available: your GM's call.
One Minor Contact per rank, for small, reliable help.
No Sanity loss when you get cybernetics.
Sense threats within 5 feet (rank 1), 50 (2) or 500 (3). Rank 4 names the main visible threat; rank 5 the main threat, seen or unseen.
Once, ever: full health, a cure, a lifted curse, or an automatic Death Save. Your GM picks the form.
Enter a sleeping target's dream with a contested WILL Essence Check; you need to see them, or a photo or feed. Fail, and not again until they sleep anew.
+10 Skill Points per rank.
INT Essence Checks to remember succeed automatically, unless you're incapacitated, head-injured or drugged.
Once per encounter, re-roll a botch on your chosen Skill; no LUCK on the re-roll. A different Skill each rank.
One favor per rank; spending one lowers the rank by 1.
+1d4 Kicker Die on Medical Skill Checks; stacks with other kickers.
One follower or companion per rank, with your GM's approval.
+3 to Stealth Skill Checks.
A counterfeit TAG: seeing through it takes an Investigation or Security check at 30 (27 with corporate AI), and shows only that it's fake.
+1 attack a round per rank with firearms.
+1 max HP on every Health Level per rank.
+1d4 Kicker Die on Combat Sense Skill Checks.
Immune to one otherwise lethal thing, agreed with your GM.
WILL Essence Checks: TN −1.
Once per encounter, improvise a device from tech in reach: +3 to TECH Skill Checks while it works. A complex one needs basic tools.
At 0 health, make attacks equal to your BOD, then fall unconscious and make Death Saves as normal.
Take 6 on Programming, Basic Tech and Engineering; anyone you help with a TECH Skill gets +1. Not in combat.
A Minor Milestone at rank 1 and at rank 2; a Major Milestone at rank 3.
Older than you look: 70–140 years (rank 1), 110–220 (2), 150–300 (3).
LUCK: a Boost costs 1, an Explode 2.
With technology, Take 6 on Basic Tech, Engineering, Interface, Robotics and Pilot.
INT and TECH Essence Checks: TN −1 (to a minimum of 1).
Magic's effects on you, good or bad, are halved.
You can deal with spirits of the dead and beings from beyond the veil.
+1 attack a round per rank with melee attacks.
No penalty on visual Awareness checks in low or no light.
Nine extra Death Saves in your lifetime: when one fails, roll again from the pool. It never refills.
Ignore 1 Pain Level per rank.
Draw and use a weapon as a free action; aimed shots keep their full Accuracy bonus.
Out of combat, heal ×2 (rank 1), ×3 (2) or ×4 (3).
Your chosen Skill explodes on a natural 9 or 10 (not on a Combat Cunning stunt). A different Skill each rank.
Your name opens doors: a neighborhood (rank 1), the LINK (2), a sector (3), whole territories (4).
After a successful melee parry, deal your weapon's damage (no BOD bonus) to the attacker, as your stunt.
Hand-to-hand and blunt melee damage to you is halved, rounded down.
Always know the cardinal directions; Take 6 on Survival to navigate.
On a successful Parry against a projectile you can see, catch it.
Once per rank a session, an EMP Essence Check (Target 8, Threshold 2) calls your guide: a 1d4 kicker, a small secret, or −5 difficulty on an unopposed check.
Aimed ranged shots from a moving vehicle keep their Accuracy bonus, and Bullseye's damage.
+1 Natural Armor per rank; Armor Piercing doesn't touch it.
Ignore the bonus damage from normal hits to the head; exploded damage still counts.
Always know the time. Once per session, Take 8 on a Skill Check about time or timing.

Once per encounter, a 12-round aura: supernatural beings within 10 feet take a −3 Pain Penalty; your Essence Checks against supernatural powers are TN −2; magic and psychic powers against you fail 85% of the time.
Surprise gives no Synergy Bonus against you.
Once per combat per rank, add your Acrobatics rank to a Dodge check; a natural 1 on it doesn't botch.
+Ç10,000 to start.
+Ç2,000 a month per rank.
You can go 2 days without (rank 1), 18 hours (2) or 6 hours (3). Withdrawal: WILL and COOL Essence TN +1, and Pain Level +1 for a week (rank 2) or +2 for two weeks (3), until your next fix.
BOD max 5, REF max 6, MOB max 6.
You're 13 to 15: dependent or emancipated, kept out of places, and a target.
Sanity −15%.

Start of combat: a Sanity Check. Fail, and you're berserk for the encounter: attack any threat, −2 on defense, +2 to hit and +4 damage hand to hand, COOL TN +1. Break it with COOL (Target 9, Threshold 3) each turn; stop an attack on an ally with COOL (Target 9, Threshold 2).
Sanity −5%.
First blood in an encounter: a Sanity Check. Pass, and it's off until the next one. Fail, and Combat Sense Checks fail on a natural 2 or 3 for the rest of it (a 1 still botches).
No initiative roll: you act last every round, and can't prepare actions in the first.
Start of combat: COOL Essence Check (Target 9, Threshold 2). Fail, and you flee: no combat actions, and enemies in range get an attack on you. Try again at the end of each turn.
A supernatural curse worked out with your GM, stronger each rank.
No cybernetics or nanotech: implants make you ill until they're out, and nanites fail.
−2 on the Skill your defect hurts; a different defect each rank.
Mortal threats start a level higher; each other party member with it adds a threat.
Awareness and Combat Sense Checks fail on a natural 2 or 3 (a 1 still botches).
BOD max 8, MOB max 3.
+3 to Stealth when hiding. At most 3'6" tall.
Someone wants you dead: one person (rank 1), a small group (2), an agency or gang (3), a corporation (4).
Sanity −15%.
EMP Essence Checks: TN +1. Once per encounter, a Sanity Check keeps you from lashing out at whoever challenges your belief.
To lie: MAG Essence Check (Target 10, Threshold 3). Pass, and the lie costs 30% Sanity for 24 hours; fail, and you can't.
BOD max 11, REF max 5, MOB max 8.
Melee and Martial Arts damage to you −4.
Attackers get +1 Accuracy against you, even behind cover. +2 automatic hits on BOD Essence Checks grappling someone smaller. At least 6'10".
Intuition checks to spot a lie fail on a natural 2 or 3 (a 1 still botches), unless the lie is preposterous.
Sanity −25%.
A failed Sanity Check brings a hallucination for 1d4 rounds: Awareness and Combat Sense checks fail, and telling friend from foe takes an EMP Essence Check (Target 10, Threshold 1).
After bleeding damage, a Medical check at 18 stops it and costs your next turn. Fail, and you pass out after rounds equal to your BOD; try again each turn. Medical tech stops it too.
Sanity −5% per rank.
A trait per rank (paranoia, a temper, lying…), chosen with your GM. IP buys it off between sessions.
Supernatural threats start a level higher; each other party member with it adds a threat.
With strangers: Persuasion one Difficulty Level harder and MAG Essence Threshold +1, each +1 more per rank after the first.
A supernatural bond on your GM's terms. Go against it, and until you keep it again: no LUCK, and every Essence Check is Threshold +1.
Pain Level +1 once you're hurt.
Start of combat: EMP Essence Check (Target 9, Threshold 2), or you refuse to fight. Try again at the end of each turn.
At least Ç75,000 in debt, Ç20,000 more each rank. No legal weapons, armor or vehicles until it's paid, and half of what you earn goes to it.
Persuasion checks fail on a natural 2 or 3 (a 1 still botches).
Always at Pain Level 1, on top of lost Health Levels.
BOD, REF and MOB Essence Checks: TN +1. Without a cure, death in 5 + 1d4 months.
LUCK: a Boost costs 3, an Explode 4.
WILL Essence Checks: TN +1.
